category: Usenet release listing (French-language, names only, no NZB download)

free_tier.stated: Free registration, then a listing of new Usenet releases with their real title and their newsgroup source name. The site serves no NZB file.
free_tier.notes: A listing site: the reader copies the Source name into an NZB search engine elsewhere.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: no object is served

retention.stated: not stated on the pages read. A third-party listing claims 'Approximately 4,000 days of archive'.

egress.terms: Nothing is retrievable from this site: the vendor page says NZB files cannot be downloaded here, so retrieval has to go through a separate NZB search engine and a news provider.

interface_detail: A web listing behind a login; a third-party listing calls the platform Newznab and says it needs NZB-Monkey software, but the vendor page says NZB files cannot be downloaded from the site.
tooling: The Source name on each row is the search term to paste into an NZB search engine; the vendor page points to a tools page for how to fetch an item.
chaining: A French-language release discovery step in front of an NZB indexer that serves the file; it replaces no indexer.

limits.value: none applicable: no NZB file is served; each entry gives a source name to search for elsewhere

limits_note: The missing download is not a counter; no vocabulary kind names a listing that serves no object.
binding_note: No counter binds because nothing is served; the verdict carries the finding.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the register page text shows a password rule of at least 6 characters and no other field was readable; the home page says registration is required and free.

reliability_note: unverified: one read of three pages; no outage observed.
confidence_note: The no-download statement and the free mandatory registration are first-party text read; the sign-up fields beyond the password rule were not readable.

evidence.quote: Sur ce site il n'est pas possible de télécharger des fichiers NZB.
evidence.proved: the site does not allow NZB file downloads

evidence.quote: Une inscription est obligatoire car elle sécurise les données indexées sur le réseau Usenet. Cet enregistrement est gratuit!
Le mot de passe doit faire au minimum 6 caractères.
evidence.proved: the register form has a password of at least 6 characters
third-party: the listing claims about 4,000 days of archive
third-party: the listing says the platform needs NZB-Monkey software

notes: The verdict term fails-egress stands for 'serves no file': no vocabulary term names a listing that returns no object.
